Use Bamboo as the CI tool on Windows OS, with PowerShell access, and manage services like Redis and RabbitMQ for integration tests (U7).
Define the shared JAR location as the xd/lib folder, with classloader isolation by bundling JARs in custom modules when necessary to handle version conflicts (U8).

Access to necessary infrastructure (e.g., EC2 instances, Windows machine, HDFS, Bamboo server, development tools) is available and configured.
The custom module is a standard Spring-based application with no unique complexities beyond typical enterprise development scenarios.
